text: BSA/AML program annual review completed 2025-12-15. Overall rating: Satisfactory. Minor findings in CDD refresh timeliness for high-risk customers. Remediation deadline: 2026-03-31.
OCC Safety and Soundness examination completed 2025-11-20. BSA/AML component rated 2 (Satisfactory). Examiners noted improvement in transaction monitoring calibration since prior exam.

CTR filing compliance audit Q4-2025. 247 CTRs filed. 3 late filings identified (>15 day delay). Root cause: teller training gap at Brickell Avenue branch. Corrective action: mandatory refresher training completed 2026-01-15.
SAR filing timeliness review Q1-2026. 34 SARs filed. 2 filings exceeded 30-day deadline. Contributing factor: analyst staffing shortage during February. Additional analyst hired effective 2026-03-01.

OFAC screening system validation completed 2026-02-28. Screening engine tested against OFAC sample dataset. Hit rate: 99.2%. 4 false negatives identified in fuzzy name matching for Arabic transliterations. Vendor patch applied.

Regulation E compliance review 2025. 142 unauthorized transaction claims processed. Average provisional credit issuance: 4.2 business days (within 10-day requirement). Zero regulatory complaints filed with CFPB.
Customer Due Diligence (CDD) program review. 2,847 customer profiles reviewed. 12 high-risk customers overdue for EDD refresh (>12 months since last review). Remediation in progress.
FinCEN 314(a) search compliance. All 52 weekly 314(a) subject searches completed on time in 2025. 3 positive matches identified and reported within 14-day response window.

FinCEN 314(b) information sharing participation. Active sharing agreements with 8 financial institutions. 14 information requests sent, 11 received in 2025. Key intelligence obtained for CASE-2026-0013 (synthetic identity ring).

Beneficial Ownership Information (BOI) compliance under Corporate Transparency Act. 342 legal entity accounts updated with beneficial owner information. 18 accounts pending beneficial owner verification.

Wire transfer recordkeeping compliance (31 CFR 1020.410). Random sample of 200 wire transfers reviewed. All records contain required fields: originator name, address, account number, beneficiary information. 2 records missing originator SSN.
Fair Lending compliance review 2025. HMDA data analysis shows no statistically significant disparities in approval rates across protected classes. Pricing analysis within acceptable tolerance bands.

CRA examination preparation. Community Reinvestment Act self-assessment completed. Lending test: Satisfactory. Investment test: Outstanding. Service test: Satisfactory. Overall projected rating: Satisfactory.

Transaction monitoring system tuning report Q1-2026. 4,221 alerts generated. True positive rate: 12.4%. False positive rate: 87.6%. 3 tuning scenarios recommended to reduce false positives by estimated 15%.
BSA training compliance report 2025. 98.7% of staff completed annual BSA/AML training. 4 employees overdue (on extended leave). Board of Directors BSA briefing completed 2025-10-15.
Privacy/GLBA compliance review. Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act privacy notice distribution verified. Customer opt-out tracking current. Information security program assessment: effective.
Regulation CC funds availability compliance. 500 check deposits sampled. All hold notifications provided within required timeframes. Exception holds properly documented with customer notice.
UDAAP risk assessment 2026. No unfair, deceptive, or abusive acts or practices identified in current product offerings. Fee schedule review completed. Overdraft program disclosures updated.

Marijuana banking compliance review. Green Leaf Dispensary (ACC-10075) quarterly enhanced monitoring completed. All cash deposits documented with CTRs. SAR filing not warranted based on current activity.
NACHA ACH rules compliance audit. Return rate: 0.8% (within 1% threshold). Unauthorized return rate: 0.3% (within 0.5% threshold). All third-party sender agreements current.
Vendor due diligence review for transaction monitoring system vendor (AMLSmart Inc). SOC 2 Type II report reviewed. No material exceptions. Contract renewed through 2028.
Elder financial exploitation program review. 18 elder abuse cases investigated in 2025. Teller red flag training completed at all branches. APS referral procedures current.
FedNow Service compliance implementation review. Real-time payment risk controls validated. Fraud screening threshold set at $5,000 for manual review. Velocity limits configured: max 5 payments/hour.
FinCEN Geographic Targeting Order (GTO) compliance for Miami-Dade County real estate transactions. 12 all-cash real estate purchases filed per GTO requirements in 2025.
Customer complaint analysis for CFPB reporting. 47 complaints received in 2025. 42 resolved within 15 days. 5 required extended investigation. Zero complaints escalated by CFPB.

Suspicious Activity Report narrative quality review. Sample of 15 SARs reviewed for completeness and narrative quality. 12 met standards. 3 required supplemental information (missing subject date of birth, incomplete transaction detail).
Independent BSA/AML testing (external auditor). Annual independent test by Baker Tilly LLP completed. Overall assessment: Adequate with minor exceptions. 3 recommendations for improvement noted.
Regulation D savings transaction limit compliance (post-2020 amendment). Monitoring in place for excessive savings withdrawals. No violations detected in current period.
TILA/Regulation Z disclosure compliance for consumer lending. Random sample of 50 loan files reviewed. All Truth in Lending disclosures accurate. APR calculations verified.
Cybersecurity compliance assessment per FFIEC guidance. Multi-factor authentication in place for all online banking. Penetration testing completed quarterly. No critical vulnerabilities outstanding.

BSA/AML risk assessment annual update 2026. Overall institutional risk rating: Moderate. Key risk drivers: international wire volume, cash-intensive business accounts, Miami geographic risk. Mitigation controls rated effective.

Regulation E error resolution compliance tracking. 89 error claims in Q1-2026. Average resolution time: 7.2 business days. All within 10-business day provisional credit deadline. Extended investigation notices sent for 12 claims.
HMDA data quality verification. 2025 HMDA LAR data validated. 12,847 applications reported. Error rate: 0.3% (well below 5% threshold). Data submitted to CFPB by March 1 deadline.
Flood insurance compliance review. 100% of loans in flood zones have current flood insurance certificates on file. 3 force-placed insurance actions taken for lapsed policies.

Bank Secrecy Act 5-year record retention compliance verification. Records sampled from 2021 through 2025. All CTRs, SARs, and supporting documentation retained per 31 CFR 1010.430. Electronic records properly indexed.
Consumer privacy incident tracking 2025. 2 data incidents reported. Both contained within 24 hours. Customer notifications sent per state breach notification laws. No regulatory enforcement actions.
Cryptocurrency-related customer due diligence procedures review. 14 customers with identified cryptocurrency exchange activity. All subject to enhanced transaction monitoring. CDD records current.

Wire transfer fraud prevention controls assessment. Dual authorization requirement in place for wires >$10,000. Callback verification for new beneficiaries. 2 BEC attempts detected and prevented in Q1-2026.

ATM/debit card fraud monitoring compliance. Real-time fraud scoring active on all debit card transactions. Velocity rules calibrated quarterly. Card reissuance within 5 business days for compromised cards.
Patriot Act Section 326 Customer Identification Program review. Documentary and non-documentary identity verification procedures current. 99.8% of new accounts verified within required timeframes.

Petrov Trading LLC enhanced due diligence documentation. EDD file reviewed per quarterly schedule. Updated risk assessment reflects critical risk rating. Supporting documentation includes transaction analysis, graph analysis results, and SAR filings.
Board BSA/AML report Q1-2026. SAR filing volume: 34 (up 15% from Q4-2025). CTR filing volume: 247. Active investigations: 8. Regulatory exam findings remediation: on track.
Zelle/P2P payment fraud loss tracking. $42,000 in P2P fraud losses in Q1-2026. 65% attributed to authorized push payment scams. Enhanced customer warnings implemented at payment initiation.
International correspondent banking due diligence. Annual review of 4 correspondent bank relationships completed. All banks maintain adequate AML programs. SWIFT KYC Registry data verified.
Model risk management review for fraud detection models. 3 models validated: transaction monitoring, customer risk scoring, and network analysis. All models within acceptable performance thresholds.
Business continuity plan testing for BSA/AML operations. Tabletop exercise completed simulating extended system outage. Manual SAR/CTR filing procedures validated. Recovery time objective: 4 hours.
Check 21/Reg CC compliance for remote deposit capture. Image quality standards validated. Duplicate detection system tested with 100% detection rate. Customer agreements current.

Suspicious activity monitoring for MSB/money service business customers. 8 MSB accounts subject to enhanced monitoring. Quarterly reviews completed. 1 account flagged for increased volume beyond stated business profile.

Sanctions screening backlog cleared. 14 pending OFAC screening alerts resolved. 1 true positive identified (Petrov network, CASE-2026-0026). Remaining 13 determined to be false positives after enhanced review.
Annual compliance calendar review for 2026. All regulatory filing deadlines documented. Responsible parties assigned. Automated reminders configured 30, 15, and 5 days prior to each deadline.
